heading: Показатели материалоемкости

method.rendering: Poppler pdftoppm; full physical page16 at180dpi; requested PDF-point bounding boxes and header context rendered directly by Poppler at864dpi (12pixels per PDF point)
method.inspection: All readings manually visually verified through view_image on original page raster and separate high-resolution crops; no OCR, extracted text, other transcripts, pilot answers, root reports or source code used.
method.bbox_coordinate_system: PDF points, unrotated page, origin at top left. Crop pixel bounds floor(x0*12),floor(y0*12),ceil(x1*12),ceil(y1*12).

inline_regions.context: Надстрочная цифра 3 справа от «м» в заголовке «Бетон, м³».
Надстрочная цифра 3 справа от «м» в правом подзаголовке стали «на 1 м³», следующая строка «бетона».

limits: Only literal visual readings; no conclusions about applicability or correctness of any bill-of-quantities position.
Line breaks and layout spacing normalized; superscript digit3 represented by Unicode³ in normalized unit headings. Inline region text records the digit itself as3.
Hyphens in steel cells are preserved as textual dashes, not interpreted as numeric zero.
Poppler emitted optional nameToUnicode warnings for Bulgarian/Greek/Thai; requested page and regions rendered successfully and visible Cyrillic text and numeric glyphs were legible.
